deep_links.note: Scenario deep links select a scenario in the scenarios viewer. TradePath deep links (e.g. /?zone=hvac) open the matching IWSDK Training Centre zone. Neither teleports a player.

description: Agent-discovery catalog for the SmartCiti.X learner platform (staging): learner VR entry, cohort dashboard v2 (demo), learner-progress contract + sample log, and 6 runnable training scenarios. Demo mode — sample data, not real learners. Simulation only — NOT certification, licensure, or clinical training. SmartCiti.X is proposed, not incorporated / funded / offered.
limits: Demo mode only — sample data (20 events, 5 pseudonymised learners), not real learners.
Simulation only — NOT certification, licensure, or clinical training.
Louisiana + Indiana training sites are proposed/planned; no site, city, or address named.
The 111-hall roster in the SmartCiti.X bundle is an in-repo list; 0 of 111 signed off by a named practitioner — a named hall is not a partner.
No real Quest / headset / phone run has been done in this environment.
No accounts, no login, no learner data leaves the session.

state_surface.note: No HTTP API exists. Learner progress is a local sample log + in-page computation (dashboard demo, vr-entry) and in-memory checklist state (scenario viewer). No live data feed, no MCP server, no webhooks, no Real mode. Real mode needs a validated log owner and anonymisation rules (open question).
